description_en: Deletes a cache disk from a file gateway
description_zh: 在文件网关下删除缓存盘
kebab_example: aliyun sgw delete-gateway-cache-disk --gateway-id gw-0001xv7je3580031y000 --cache-id d-bp1dcnq8zldree6ok000 --local-file-path /dev/vdb --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteGatewayCacheDisk

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cache disk. You can call the DescribeGatewayCaches operation to query the ID of the cache disk
parameters.help_zh: 缓存盘ID。可以通过DescribeGatewayCaches接口获得
parameters.name: cache_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the device that corresponds to the cache disk. You can call the DescribeGatewayCaches operation to query the name of the device
parameters.help_zh: 缓存盘内部设备名。 可以通过DescribeGatewayCaches接口获得
parameters.name: local_file_path
